regions.name: Crossroads
regions.description: A gallows tree leans over four rutted roads. Crows watch you choose which one to die on.

regions.name: Ashen Marsh
regions.description: Fog, iron, and things that breathe under the water.

regions.name: Drowned Chapel
regions.description: A half-sunken nave where the bell still tolls beneath black water. Something kneels at the altar and does not turn around.

regions.name: Bleak Forest
regions.description: Leafless trees grown too close together, their bark scarred with claw marks at the height of a man's throat.

regions.name: Iron Keep
regions.description: A rusted fortress whose garrison never left. Their armor still marches the walls, empty and patient.

regions.name: Bone Catacombs
regions.description: Miles of stacked skulls and cold, patient dark. The deepest vault holds Grimhold's last, hungry secret.

regions.name: Rotting Village
regions.description: Doors hang open on empty homes. The well bubbles, and the church bell rings with no one pulling the rope.

regions.name: Hag's Hollow
regions.description: A sink of black mud and hanging charms of teeth and hair. Something old is humming a lullaby just out of sight.

regions.name: Frozen Pass
regions.description: A knife-edged mountain road where the wind carries voices of the travellers it buried.

regions.name: Obsidian Spire
regions.description: A glass-black tower rising from the ice, its stairs worn smooth by centuries of those who went up and never came down.
